body:
Incoming main `01527b1b9e74dd88bbfca179354fa2b17269212f` retains status-directory insertion search state. During source integration of main `e177a4f4ec59ca53051b6e2322626eb50daeed43`, two boundaries require repair before adoption is qualified. This is source discovery; no new compiled or allocation result is claimed.

`status_prefix.rs` calls `reused_cursor::allocate(function,budget,phase)` before that callee acquires its argument/formal/Result roles in `reused_cursor.rs:5–18`. The held-prefix bank does not explicitly cover those distinct roles. The indexed dispatch also forms an index borrow before its corresponding reservation, and `insert_reusing_cursor` acquires its own ABI inside the callee. Establish an explicit complete caller prepayment map, preserving original authentication, work, failure and Drop order.

The original new tests create both `before` and `current` with the new `held_prefix`, then remove the before cursor. This preserves useful parity assertions but charges/allocates new setup on the apparent old baseline. Retain those entire tests, and additionally compile the complete pre-01527 producer and tariffs independently for real old/current setup, insertion, allocation and paid-byte measurements.

Acceptance:
- Acquire all actual caller/formal/return/receiving/borrow roles before formation; only eliminate fees for physically absent roles. No refunds, raised caps, or padded old baseline.
- Preserve the full incoming implementation, original tests and source evidence, along with a full independently executable immediate-old producer.
- Add actual setup and insertion exact/one-short/zero/floor/sticky/foreign/full-six-field diagnostic and full Drop controls. Preserve every original work/order/link/key comparison.
- Qualify in the existing large focused batch with scoped production Clippy; report actual complete old/current paid and physical outcomes including setup overhead. No full suites or benchmark gain claim from source analysis.

Implementation is assigned to the isolated external-SSD main-integration lane. This follow-up does not reopen previously closed tickets.
title: (OPT) Prepay retained status-cursor callers and compare the complete old producer
